By selling an article at (18)/(25) of its actual selling price, a loss of 19% is incurred. What is the profit percentage on selling it at its actual selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss on selling the article at 18/25 of SP = 19%

**Formula Used:**

Loss% = (cost price - selling price)/cost price × 100

Profit% = (selling price - cost price)/cost price × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of that article be Rs. 100x

Selling price when sold at (18)/(25) of SP = 100x - (19% of 100x )

⇒ 100x - (19/100 × 100) = 81x

Original selling price = (25/18) × 81x = 112.5x

Required profit % = [(112.5x - 100x)/100x] × 100

⇒ (12.5x/100x) × 100 = 12.5%

**∴ The profit on selling it at its actual SP is 12.5%.**

questions.question: The average age of a husband and his wife was 20 years at the time of their marriage. After 6 years, they have a 2 -year old child. Find the present average age of the family.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average age at the time of marriage = 20 years.

Their child's age after 6 years = 2 years

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Total age at the time of their marriage = 20 × 2

⇒ 40 years

Present age of husband and wife together = 40 + 6 + 6

⇒ 52 years

Total age of the family = 52 + 2 = 54 years

The average age of the family = 54/3 = 18 years

**∴ The present average age of the family is 18 years.**

questions.question: The average of 39% of A and 42% of B is equal to three-fifths of the difference of A and B. Find B as a percentage of A.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 39% of A and 42% of B is equal to three-fifths of the difference of A and B.

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

[A × (39/100) + B × (42/100)]/2 = (A - B) × (3/5)

⇒ [(39A + 42B)/100]/2 = (3A - 3B)/5

⇒ (39A + 42B)/200 = (3A - 3B)/5

⇒ (39A + 42B)/40 = (3A - 3B)

⇒ 39A + 42B = 120A - 120B

⇒ 42B + 120B = 120A - 39A

⇒ 162B = 81A

⇒ B/A = 81/162

So, ratio of B and A = 81 : 162 or 1 : 2

So, B = (1/2) × 100 of A or 50% of A

∴** Required answer is 50%.**

questions.question: Find the least number that should be added to 1014 such that the resulting number can be divided by 3, 4, 5 and 6 , leaving no remainder.
questions.solution:

The numbers are 3, 4, 5 and 6

The closest number is 1014

**Concept used:**

LCM method.

Divide the LCM with the closest divisible number present in question.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 3, 4, 5, and 6 = 60

Now,

By dividing 1014 by 60 we get 54 as the remainder

So, the least number required to get a fully divisible number

⇒ (60 - 54) = 6

**∴ The required number is 6.**

questions.question: Two-thirds of half of three-eighths of a number is 40. What is 80% of that number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two-thirds of half of the three-eighths of a number is 40

**Calculation:**

Let the number be N

According to the question,

(2/3) of (1/2) of (3/8) of N = 40

⇒ (2/3) × (1/2) × (3/8) × N = 40

⇒ N × (1/8) = 40

⇒ N = 40 × 8

⇒ N = 320

So, the number is 320

Now, 80% of 320 = 320 × (80/100)

⇒ 32 × 8 = 256

**∴ 80% of that number is 256.**

questions.question: The population of a town at the start of a year was 850000 . In the first year, there was a growth in the population at a rate of 12 per thousand, and in the next year, there was a decrease in the population at a rate of 1%. The population at the end of two years is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Present population = 850000

First year increment = 12 per 1000

Second year decreament = 1%

**Formula used:**

Final year population = Present population × (100 ± R)/100

Here, R = increm
ent or decrement

**Calculation:**

12 for 1000 = 1.2%

Final year population = 850000 × (100 + 1.2)/100 × (100 - 1)/100

⇒ 850000 × (101.2/100) × (99/100)

⇒ 851598

**∴ The population at the end of two years is 851598.**

questions.question: The cost price of a book is ₹ 250. If the successive discounts offered on the book are 10%, 15% and 20%, then find the overall discount % of the book.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price of a book = ₹ 250.

The successive discounts offered are 10%, 15% and 20%

**Concept used:**

Successive discount = x + y - (x × y)/100

Here, x and y are two individual discounts 

**Calculation:**

Overall discount of 1st two discount = 10 + 15 - (10 × 15)/100

⇒ 25 - 1.5 = 23.5%

Now, Effective successive discount = 23.5 + 20 - (23.5 × 20)/100

⇒ 43.5 - 4.7 = 38.8%

**∴ The overall discount % of the book is 38.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

Discounts given are 10%, 15% and 20% respectively

So, SP = 250 × (100-10)/100 × (100 - 15)/100 × (100 - 20)/100

⇒ 250 × 9/10 × 85/100 × 8/10

⇒ 250 × 6120/10000

⇒ 153

Discount% = [(250 - 153)/250] × 100

⇒ 9.7 × 4 = 38.8

**Hence, the overall discount is 38.8%**.

questions.question: Suraj can complete a certain work in the same time in which Manoj and Rajesh together can complete it. If Rajesh can alone complete it in 28 days and Suraj and Manoj together can complete it in 14 days, then in how many days can Manoj alone complete it?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by Suraj = time taken by Manoj + Rajesh

Time taken by Rajesh = 28 days

Time taken by Suraj and Manoj together = 14 days

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

Calculation:

Let total work be 28 units [As LCM of 14, 28 is 28]

So, efficiency of Rajesh (R) = 28/28 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of Suraj and Manoj (S + M) = 28/14 

⇒ S + M = 2 units/day

According to the question,

Efficiency of Suraj = Efficiency of Manoj + Rajesh

⇒ S = M + 1

⇒ S + M = M + 1 + M

⇒ 2 = 2M + 1

⇒ 2 - 1 = 2M

⇒ 1 = 2M

⇒ M= 0.5

So, the efficiency of Manoj = 0.5

Required Time = 28/0.5

⇒ 56 days.

**∴ Manoj alone completes it in 56 days.**

questions.question: A person walked from a village to a hospital at a speed of 30 km/h and walked back at a speed of 2 km/h. If the whole journey took 4 h 36 min, find the distance of the hospital from the village.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 4 h 36 min = 4.6 hours

Shortcut formula: Distance = [ (Product of Speeds) ÷ (Sum of Speeds) ] × Total Time

Distance = [ (30 × 2) ÷ (30 + 2) ] × 4.6

Distance = [ 60 ÷ 32 ] × 4.6 = 1.875 × 4.6 = 8.625 km

8.625 km = 8 5/8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 8 5/8 km.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from Village to Hospital (s₁) = 30 km/h

Speed from Hospital to Village (s₂) = 2 km/h

Total time taken = 4 h 36 min

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c88935600c168e204ab077cdc8e2f1b628d0b01d1c38c600bcd6f19d279395.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Time = 4 h + (36 ÷ 60) h = 4 + 3/5 = 23/5 hours

⇒ Let the distance be d km.

⇒ (d ÷ 30) + (d ÷ 2) = 23/5

⇒ (d + 15d) ÷ 30 = 23/5

⇒ 16d ÷ 30 = 23/5

⇒ 16d = (23 × 30) ÷ 5

⇒ 16d = 23 × 6

⇒ 16d = 138

⇒ d = 138 ÷ 16 = 69 ÷ 8

⇒ d = 8 5/8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 8 5/8 km.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Constant Distance

When an object covers the same distance at two different speeds s₁ and s₂, the average speed = (2 × s₁ × s₂) ÷ (s₁ + s₂).

Speed-Time Relationship

If distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (s₁ ÷ s₂ = t₂ ÷ t₁). Ratio of speeds 30:2 = 15:1 implies ratio of times is 1:15.

Unit Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18.</p

questions.question: Two trains starting at the same time from two stations 300 km apart and going in opposite directions cross each other at a distance of 180 km from one of the stations. What is the ratio of speeds of faster train to slower train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When travel time is constant, Speed is directly proportional to Distance.

Distance covered by the faster train = 180 km

Distance covered by the slower train = 300 − 180 = 120 km

Ratio of speeds = Ratio of distances = 180 : 120

Speed Ratio = 3 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance between the two stations = 300 km

Distance covered by the faster train before crossing = 180 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bab2e62bc296011a93d54715b26f8bdf935eabac2f62a02ba88e5fae74c5ce54.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered by the slower train = 300 − 180 = 120 km

⇒ Since both trains start at the same time and cross each other, the time traveled by both is perfectly equal.

⇒ Let the time taken be t hours.

⇒ Speed of faster train = 180 ÷ t

⇒ Speed of slower train = 120 ÷ t

⇒ Ratio of speeds = (180 ÷ t) : (120 ÷ t)

⇒ Ratio of speeds = 180 : 120

⇒ Speed ratio = 3 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Directions)

When two bodies move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). The time taken for them to meet is Total Distance ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Constant Time Principle

When the travel time is constant for two moving bodies, the ratio of their speeds is directly proportional to the ratio of the distances they cover: S₁ ÷ S₂ = D₁ ÷ D₂.

Constant Distance Principle

When the distance covered is constant for two moving bodies, their speeds are inversely proportional to the time taken: S₁ ÷ S₂ = T₂ ÷ T₁.

questions.question: If the average of 5 consecutive odd integers in increasing order is 11 , then the average of the last 3 of them is:
questions.solution:

Average of 5 consecutive odd integers in increasing order = 11

**Formula used:**

Average = Total sum/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Let 5 consecutive odd numbers be a, a + 2, a + 4, a + 6, and a + 8

According to the question,

a + a + 2 + a + 4 + a + 6 + a + 8 = 5 × 11

⇒ 5a + 20 = 55 

⇒ 5a = 35

⇒ a = 35/5 = 7

Now,

The last three numbers are 11, 13, 15

Total = 11 + 13 + 15

⇒ 39

Average = 39/3 = 13

**∴ The average of the last 3 of them is 13.**

questions.question: A can complete a work in 25 days and B can complete it in 30 days. If they work on it together for 5 days, then the fraction of the work that is left will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete work = 25 days

Time taken by B to complete work = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

LCM of 25 and 30 = 150 i.e total work

Efficiency of A = 150/25 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of B = 150/30 = 5 units/day

Effective efficiency = 6 + 5 = 11 units/day

Total work complete = 5 × 11 = 55 units

Remaining 150 - 55 = 95 units

Fraction of the work left = 95/150 = 19/30

**∴ The fraction of the work that is left will be 19/30.**

questions.question: How much time will it take for a sum of ₹ 900 to yield ₹ 810 as interest at 5% per annum of simple interest?
questions.solution:

Sum = 900

Simple Interest (SI) = 810

Rate of interest = 5%

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Here, P = Sum, T = Time, R = Rate 

**Calculation:**

Let the time needed is T years

According to the question,

810 = (900 × 5 × T)/100

⇒ 45T = 810

⇒ T = 810/45

⇒ T = 18

So, Time = 18 years

**∴ The required time is 18 years.**
